capabilities: Generate formatted LaTeX matrices from a dialog window
Choose matrix width, height and bracket type
Enter values in per-cell inputs and write the resulting LaTeX
Insert fractions, subscripts and superscripts with shorthand like {n}/{m}
extras: The README warns the output is not automatically wrapped in $ signs; users must add them manually. Manual installation only is described.
problem: Writing LaTeX matrices by hand in math blocks is tedious because of the environment syntax, alignment markers and repeated ampersands.
summary: Matrix generator that opens a window where you set dimensions and bracket type, fill cells, and get formatted LaTeX matrix code to paste.
